import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix label variants in species (strip spaces)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    # Fix label variants in island (lowercase to standardize)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.lower().str.capitalize()
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas first)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Group by sex and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
